newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks dragged lower by Commercial Bank.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks dragged lower by Commercial Bank.

text.p: Most shares were unchanged on the Ghana stock exchange on Wednesday after a lackluster session, but the index ended lower because of another drop in the price of Ghana Commercial Bank (GCB).
GCB was weak last month, when dealers said investors were disappointed by the 1996 dividend, and was the only faller on Wednesday, losing 27 cedis to 520 on light volume of 7,700 shares.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 2.71 points to 382.69.
Volume was relatively high at 598,710 shares, but the bulk of that was accounted for by the 509,500 shares traded in Mechanical Lloyd, which ended unchanged at 120 cedis.
Two shares ended higher, with Unilever adding five cedis to 930 and CFAO three to 33.
